capabilities: Export notes, selections, or folders as PNG, JPG, WebP, or PDF
Preview and adjust width, padding, format, resolution, watermark, and author info before export
Split long notes into multiple images by fixed height, horizontal rule, or paragraph-based pagination
Add text or image watermarks, including invisible pixel watermarks, and author info
Export files from the Obsidian CLI via an exportFileToPath() API
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not upload or share to any service; it only produces image and PDF files locally.
extras: README says the plugin may not yet be available in the Community plugins browser, and that main.js must be manually replaced and the plugin reloaded before calling the CLI API, which is desktop-only.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to export a note as a shareable image that keeps its rendered look, including themes, Mermaid diagrams, math, and callouts.
summary: Export tool that renders notes, selections, or whole folders as PNG, JPG, WebP, or PDF files with live preview, watermarks, and split output.
